ablation_0_fleet_coordination.name: Global Fleet Coordination
ablation_0_fleet_coordination.finding: Fleet coordinator bounds vehicles strictly to fleet limit, preventing $10,000 overflow penalty.

ablation_1_subproblem_selection.name: Subproblem Selection
ablation_1_subproblem_selection.finding: RL guidance prioritizes subproblems with higher detour and load stress.

ablation_2_initial_generation.name: Initial Candidate Generation
ablation_2_initial_generation.finding: Multi-temperature rollouts reduce initial route overhead and consolidate vehicles.

ablation_3_parameter_adaptation.name: QAOA Parameter Adaptation
ablation_3_parameter_adaptation.finding: Dynamic depth p and penalty lambda allocation prevents barren plateaus.

ablation_4_quantum_vs_classical_subprobl.name: Quantum vs Classical Subproblem Optimization
ablation_4_quantum_vs_classical_subprobl.finding: On 3-node subproblems, classical brute force solves in <0.1ms; QAOA finds matching permutation.

ablation_5_formulation_fidelity.name: EV-Aware vs Distance-Only QUBO
ablation_5_formulation_fidelity.finding: Load-dependent dissipation penalizes delivering heavy cargo late in the tour.

ablation_6_hybrid_refinement.name: Hybrid Refinement Stage
ablation_6_hybrid_refinement.finding: Classical local search refines routes around quantum-optimized local permutations.

ablation_7_trained_vs_untrained_policy.name: Trained RL vs Untrained Policy
ablation_7_trained_vs_untrained_policy.finding: Trained actor-critic policy achieves lower routing cost and tighter tour packing.
